claims.text: POL-NS-01 limb (c) makes the fee chargeable only where the driver 'held position inside that geofence for a continuous dwell of at least' the minimum for the zone class — here 300 seconds, the LARGE_VENUE figure. On the driver's own trace the longest continuous qualifying run inside the arrival radius is 170 seconds (18 fixes, first_ts 19:00:00, last_ts 19:02:50). It is the longest of two runs and it is 130 seconds short of the minimum, so limb (c) is not satisfied on an uninterrupted reading of the dwell.

The two in-geofence intervals are not one wait: the trace records an excursion of 5 fixes between 19:02:50 and 19:03:50 whose furthest point was 179.8 m from the pin — outside the 120 m arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. The driver left the geofence and came back, so the intervals the fee depends on are separate in-geofence intervals, which is exactly what the rider's claim puts in issue.

Take the intervals as they stand and the effective in-geofence dwell is 170 seconds against the 300 second minimum for this zone class — a shortfall of 130 seconds. POL-NS-06 provides that where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. That is the SGD 4.00 itemised as cancellation_fee in the fare breakdown.

Summing the intervals is permitted only by POL-NS-06(i), and limb (i) requires a traffic advisory 'such that holding position was not lawfully possible'. The derived recital of that limb establishes the advisory's type (CLOSURE), that its geometry covers the pickup road and that its active window covers the waiting period — it says nothing about holding being unlawful. The driver's own chat message at 19:04:05 states he is 'Back at the marked bay now', and the trace shows him then holding inside the geofence for a further 160 seconds through to cancellation at 19:06:30. On the driver's own statement the marked bay was a lawful holding place during the advisory window, so the limb (i) premise that holding position was not lawfully possible is not made out, and the intervals may not be summed.

The rider's own track places the rider's device roughly 519 m from the pin, and that does not assist the driver: POL-NS-06 refunds the fee where the dwell falls short 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. Rider presence is not an element of the shortfall route, so the state of the rider track cannot convert a 170 second hold into a chargeable no-show.

The disputed sum is live and whole: the fare breakdown shows the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On a rider-filed dispute a shortfall under POL-NS-06 therefore returns the entirety of the contested SGD 4.00 to the rider.

claims.text: The trip_record for this trip contains a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-07T19:00:20+08:00, so limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show test is made out on the record.

The pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone — Orchard Central's marked ride-hail bay, venue_id VEN-ORCHARD-CENTRAL — so the arrival radius is 120 m and the minimum dwell is 300 seconds, not the 50 m STANDARD radius. The zone class is read from trip_record.pickup_zone_class, not assumed.

The driver's own trace places him inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius as a qualifying arrival: 35 of his 40 fixes qualify, in two continuous in-geofence runs — 170 seconds from 19:00:00 to 19:02:50, and 160 seconds from 19:03:50 to 19:06:30.

The two in-geofence intervals total 330 seconds of accumulated dwell — 30 seconds more than the 300 second minimum for this zone class — so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the accumulated measure that POL-NS-06(i) requires to be used.

POL-NS-06(i) expressly permits those separate in-geofence intervals to be summed. Every condition the limb names is met on the record: traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is present and populated with type CLOSURE, its geometry (lat 1.2997–1.3037, lng 103.8377–103.8417) covers the pickup road, its active window 18:50–19:30 covers the waiting period, and the driver's furthest point between the intervals was 179.8 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash.

The rider's central proposition — that the car left the bay so the separate waits 'should not count together' — is answered directly by POL-NS-06(i), which licenses accumulation precisely because a kerbside closure made holding position not lawfully possible for the single short circulation the driver made.

The excursion was a lawful circulation and a return, not an abandonment: the driver's furthest excursion fix was 179.8 m from the pin, well inside the 300 m leash, and the second in-geofence run begins at 19:03:50, immediately after the excursion ends at 19:03:50.

The chat log corroborates the trace: the driver messaged at 19:02:30 that 'the kerb is temporarily closed; I must circulate and will return to the same bay', and at 19:04:05 that he was 'back at the marked bay now' — timestamps that bracket the excursion and match the 19:03:50 restart of the second qualifying run.

The trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 19:06:30, after the required dwell had elapsed, and the record shows no boarding event — POL-NS-01 limb (d) holds and the driver's reason code is one of the three the clause recognises.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the chat log contains three messages — one SYSTEM arrival notice and two DRIVER messages — and no locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window, so limb (a) of that clause fails at the first step.

The rider was not at the pin: the rider's device sat 519.4 m from the pickup pin for the whole window — far outside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a LARGE_VENUE — and the rider's qualifying fix count inside that radius is zero.

POL-NS-05 does not defeat the fee. Even disregarding the 19:00:20 arrival marker and recomputing the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:00:00, the corrected dwell of 330 seconds still meets the 300 second minimum, so under POL-NS-05 limb (iii) any false marker does not by itself defeat the fee and POL-NS-01 governs the outcome.

POL-NS-03 does not govern. That clause addresses a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m; here the driver's qualifying fixes place him inside the 120 m arrival radius at the pin itself, so this is a completed arrival under POL-NS-02 and not a wrong-entrance case requiring a refund.

The fare breakdown reconciles with the fee schedule, so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the zone-class fee for LARGE_VENUE (SGD 4.00) and the vehicle-tier fee for RYDE_X (SGD 4.00) tie at SGD 4.00, and the cancellation_fee line is exactly SGD 4.00.

The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so no withholding arises and compensation is payable on this verified rider no-show.

The driver is entitled to compensation of SGD 3.20, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee itemised in the fare breakdown, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee; POL-NS-01 establishes the fee and POL-NS-07 establishes the payout.

Because all four POL-NS-01 limbs hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them, the rider's claim is not supported and under POL-GEN-03 the present state stands: the charge of SGD 4.00 remains on the fare breakdown, with refund_issued_sgd at 0.00.

ruling.explanation: Both parties read the same timeline; what divides you is whether the two spells inside the pickup geofence may be added together. Rider: the car left the bay at 19:02:50 and came back at 19:03:50, so the longest continuous hold was 170 seconds — 130 seconds short of the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum — and POL-NS-06 should return the SGD 4.00 fee. That reading would be right if the two spells had to stand alone, but POL-NS-06(i) permits them to be summed, and both of its conditions are met. The LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is present and populated, type CLOSURE, active 18:50–19:30 over the whole waiting window, its geometry covering the marked ride-hail bay, and its own description records that the temporary kerb closure required pickup vehicles to circulate before returning to the bay. The driver's furthest point during that single circulation was 179.8 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash. The runs of 170 s (19:00:00–19:02:50) and 160 s (19:03:50–19:06:30) therefore total 330 seconds, 30 seconds above the 300-second minimum. I therefore reject the rider's central claim that the waits must not count together, and the related claim that the limb (i) premise is unestablished. The driver's own message at 19:04:05 that he was 'back at the marked bay now' does not defeat limb (i): the closure required one circulation and a return to a lawful bay, which is exactly the situation the limb accommodates. On the other side, the rider is right that rider presence is not an element of the shortfall route and that the rider track 519 m from the pin assists nobody — but the shortfall route is not reached, so rider absence decides nothing. All four POL-NS-01 limbs hold: the arrived event at 19:00:20; 35 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m arrival radius; 330 seconds of accumulated dwell; driver-terminated with RIDER_NO_SHOW at 19:06:30 with no boarding event. Nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them — the arrival marker was not false (the driver was stationary inside the radius, so POL-NS-05 does not bite), POL-NS-03 does not govern because the driver was inside the radius rather than merely within 400 m of it, and POL-NS-04 fails for want of any rider locating or coordinating message. The fare reconciles: the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee of SGD 4.00 equals the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00 and the charged cancellation-fee line is SGD 4.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and both profiles being at 1 and below threshold the anti-farming check on no_show_terminations_30d does not trip. Outcome: the SGD 4.00 charge stands; under POL-NS-07 the driver is paid 80 percent of it — SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00 — and under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring the compensation figure. No referral fires: POL-NS-05(ii) requires a false arrival marker, which this was not, and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met.

To the rider: I do not accept your central claim that the two waits must be kept separate. POL-NS-06(i) allows separate in-geofence intervals to be summed when a qualifying traffic advisory covers the pickup road and the waiting period and the driver stays within 300 m of the pin. EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is a CLOSURE, active 18:50-19:30, describing a temporary kerb closure that required pickup vehicles to circulate before returning to the marked bay, and it covers the pickup road. The driver's excursion was 60 seconds (19:02:50-19:03:50), with a furthest point of 179.8 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash. The two runs are 170 s (19:00:00-19:02:50) and 160 s (19:03:50-19:06:30), totalling 330 s, which is 30 s more than the 300 s LARGE_VENUE minimum. The driver's chat messages at 19:02:30 and 19:04:05 match that trace. Your alternative reading - longest continuous run 170 s, a 130 s shortfall, and so a full refund - would be right only if the intervals could not be summed; the policy condition for summing is met. The four POL-NS-01 limbs also hold: the arrived event is at 19:00:20, the GPS trace places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 19:00:00, the accumulated dwell meets the minimum, and the trip was terminated at 19:06:30 with RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed and with no boarding. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: there is no rider locating or coordinating message in the chat, and your rider track sits about 519.4 m from the pin. POL-NS-05 does not defeat the fee, because even recomputing from the first qualifying fix the accumulated dwell still meets the minimum. POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver was inside the arrival radius. The fare breakdown reconciles: the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) tie, and the cancellation fee is SGD 4.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4. To the driver: the fee stands and you are compensated SGD 3.20, being 80% of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.20; that figure is the money the ruling moves, not a refund to the rider. No referral or escalation is produced on this record.

To both parties — the ruling on the SGD 4.00 no-show charge, and the driver's compensation.

THE CHARGE. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-09107) itemises a cancellation fee of SGD 4.00. Under the fee schedule the chargeable figure is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00); the two tie at SGD 4.00, and the billed line reconciles exactly, so there is no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d).

THE DRIVER'S ARRIVAL. The trip record (EV-TRIP-09107) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:00:20; the GPS trace (EV-GPS-09107) places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 19:00:00; and the trip was terminated by the driver at 19:06:30 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event. POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b) and (d) therefore hold. The zone class is LARGE_VENUE (Orchard Central, VEN-ORCHARD-CENTRAL), read from the trip record, so the minimum dwell is 300 seconds and the arrival radius is 120 m.

THE WAITING PERIOD — the point the rider contests. The trace shows two in-geofence holds: 170 seconds (19:00:00–19:02:50) and 160 seconds (19:03:50–19:06:30). They are separated by one circulation (19:02:50–19:03:50) whose furthest point was 179.8 m from the pin — inside the 300 m leash. The LTA traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is present and populated with type CLOSURE, its geometry covers the pickup road, its window 18:50–19:30 covers the waiting period, and the derived limb records no failed condition. POL-NS-06(i) therefore permits the two holds to be summed: 330 seconds, which is 30 seconds above the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum.

The rider's proposition that the car left the bay, so the separate waits 'should not count together', is rejected: POL-NS-06(i) exists precisely to permit summing where a kerbside closure forced the driver to leave and re-enter within the leash, and every condition it names is met here. The rider's related reading — that limb (i)'s 'holding position was not lawfully possible' premise is not made out because the driver returned to the bay and held again — is also rejected. The advisory itself directs vehicles to circulate before returning to the marked bay; the single circulation and return is the situation the limb addresses, not evidence against it, and the pre-pass found the limb available with no failed condition. With 330 seconds of effective dwell there is no shortfall and no refund under POL-NS-06.

THE RIDER'S OTHER POINTS. The rider's own track sits 519 m from the pin with no coordinating message in the chat, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider and the rider was not at the pickup point. That does not assist the rider: POL-NS-06's shortfall route is the only thing that would return the fee irrespective of rider presence, and it is not engaged because the dwell is sufficient. The contested SGD 4.00 accordingly remains charged and refund_issued_sgd stays at 0.00.

DRIVER'S COMPENSATION. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80% of SGD 4.00 = SGD 3.20 (the platform retains SGD 0.20). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4.

OUTCOME. The charge to the rider stands (NO_ACTION on the fee, per POL-NS-07), and the driver is paid SGD 3.20. The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring the driver compensation as POL-GEN-03 requires. No referral arises: nothing in POL-NS-05(ii), POL-NS-07, POL-NS-08 or POL-NS-09 directs one, and the arrival marker was not false (the driver was stationary in-geofence at the 19:00:20 marker, and the corrected dwell still meets the minimum).

ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 limb (c) makes the fee chargeable only where the driver 'held position inside that geofence for a continuous dwell of at least' the minimum for the zone class — here 300 seconds, the LARGE_VENUE figure. On the driver's own trace the longest continuous qualifying run inside the arrival radius is 170 seconds (18 fixes, first_ts 19:00:00, last_ts 19:02:50). It is the longest of two runs and it is 130 seconds short of the minimum, so limb (c) is not satisfied on an uninterrupted reading of the dwell.

The two in-geofence intervals are not one wait: the trace records an excursion of 5 fixes between 19:02:50 and 19:03:50 whose furthest point was 179.8 m from the pin — outside the 120 m arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. The driver left the geofence and came back, so the intervals the fee depends on are separate in-geofence intervals, which is exactly what the rider's claim puts in issue.

Take the intervals as they stand and the effective in-geofence dwell is 170 seconds against the 300 second minimum for this zone class — a shortfall of 130 seconds. POL-NS-06 provides that where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. That is the SGD 4.00 itemised as cancellation_fee in the fare breakdown.

Summing the intervals is permitted only by POL-NS-06(i), and limb (i) requires a traffic advisory 'such that holding position was not lawfully possible'. The derived recital of that limb establishes the advisory's type (CLOSURE), that its geometry covers the pickup road and that its active window covers the waiting period — it says nothing about holding being unlawful. The driver's own chat message at 19:04:05 states he is 'Back at the marked bay now', and the trace shows him then holding inside the geofence for a further 160 seconds through to cancellation at 19:06:30. On the driver's own statement the marked bay was a lawful holding place during the advisory window, so the limb (i) premise that holding position was not lawfully possible is not made out, and the intervals may not be summed.

The rider's own track places the rider's device roughly 519 m from the pin, and that does not assist the driver: POL-NS-06 refunds the fee where the dwell falls short 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. Rider presence is not an element of the shortfall route, so the state of the rider track cannot convert a 170 second hold into a chargeable no-show.

The disputed sum is live and whole: the fare breakdown shows the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On a rider-filed dispute a shortfall under POL-NS-06 therefore returns the entirety of the contested SGD 4.00 to the rider.
The trip_record for this trip contains a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-07T19:00:20+08:00, so limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show test is made out on the record.

The pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone — Orchard Central's marked ride-hail bay, venue_id VEN-ORCHARD-CENTRAL — so the arrival radius is 120 m and the minimum dwell is 300 seconds, not the 50 m STANDARD radius. The zone class is read from trip_record.pickup_zone_class, not assumed.

The driver's own trace places him inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius as a qualifying arrival: 35 of his 40 fixes qualify, in two continuous in-geofence runs — 170 seconds from 19:00:00 to 19:02:50, and 160 seconds from 19:03:50 to 19:06:30.

The two in-geofence intervals total 330 seconds of accumulated dwell — 30 seconds more than the 300 second minimum for this zone class — so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the accumulated measure that POL-NS-06(i) requires to be used.

POL-NS-06(i) expressly permits those separate in-geofence intervals to be summed. Every condition the limb names is met on the record: traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is present and populated with type CLOSURE, its geometry (lat 1.2997–1.3037, lng 103.8377–103.8417) covers the pickup road, its active window 18:50–19:30 covers the waiting period, and the driver's furthest point between the intervals was 179.8 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash.

The rider's central proposition — that the car left the bay so the separate waits 'should not count together' — is answered directly by POL-NS-06(i), which licenses accumulation precisely because a kerbside closure made holding position not lawfully possible for the single short circulation the driver made.

The excursion was a lawful circulation and a return, not an abandonment: the driver's furthest excursion fix was 179.8 m from the pin, well inside the 300 m leash, and the second in-geofence run begins at 19:03:50, immediately after the excursion ends at 19:03:50.

The chat log corroborates the trace: the driver messaged at 19:02:30 that 'the kerb is temporarily closed; I must circulate and will return to the same bay', and at 19:04:05 that he was 'back at the marked bay now' — timestamps that bracket the excursion and match the 19:03:50 restart of the second qualifying run.

The trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 19:06:30, after the required dwell had elapsed, and the record shows no boarding event — POL-NS-01 limb (d) holds and the driver's reason code is one of the three the clause recognises.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the chat log contains three messages — one SYSTEM arrival notice and two DRIVER messages — and no locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window, so limb (a) of that clause fails at the first step.

The rider was not at the pin: the rider's device sat 519.4 m from the pickup pin for the whole window — far outside the 150 m rider-presence radius for a LARGE_VENUE — and the rider's qualifying fix count inside that radius is zero.

POL-NS-05 does not defeat the fee. Even disregarding the 19:00:20 arrival marker and recomputing the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:00:00, the corrected dwell of 330 seconds still meets the 300 second minimum, so under POL-NS-05 limb (iii) any false marker does not by itself defeat the fee and POL-NS-01 governs the outcome.

POL-NS-03 does not govern.
